questions.question: The variational mean is correct and the optimization gradient is tiny. Why can posterior intervals still be too narrow?
options: The diagonal family cannot represent the correlated target, even at its optimum
Any Gaussian model necessarily produces wrong uncertainty
The number of optimizer iterations defines posterior variance
questions.explanation: For this KL direction and correlated target, the optimal diagonal variances are 0.36 rather than the target marginal variances of one. This is approximation error, not an unfinished optimizer.
